summary.en-US: Your tabs as cards on a spatial canvas — organize them, group them, and add notes.

description.en-US: Turn open tabs into screenshot cards on a pannable, zoomable canvas. Arrange cards into hand-drawn groups, add notes, and search your board. Everything stays locally in Firefox; cardtable has no accounts, analytics, telemetry, or servers.

version.approval_notes: cardtable has no developer servers, accounts, analytics, telemetry, or remote code. It does not send stored board data, tab data, notes, or screenshots to the developer or an analytics service. Site icons are displayed only from local image bytes; the canvas never loads remote favicon URLs. The tabs permission tracks, opens, and closes tabs; <all_urls> supports page thumbnails, titles, favicons, and scroll restoration; storage holds the local board and thumbnails. On Firefox, screenshots remain disabled until the user explicitly grants site access. The only fetch() call converts a locally generated data: screenshot URL into a Blob. Distributed JavaScript is human-readable and is not minified, bundled, or obfuscated. To test: click the toolbar button, optionally enable screenshots, browse a few pages, and return to the canvas to arrange their cards.
